arguments.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create FOUR NEW COMPLETE in-between sprites to make the supplied run-start animation join more smoothly. The first image is the existing twelve-frame art the user likes: preserve its finished clean linework, rich cel shading, KH2 Sora face/hair/costume/boots, proportions and right-facing three-quarter camera. The second image contains FOUR ROWS of start/end whole-frame pairs, left image before, right image after. Draw exactly ONE new true halfway pose for EACH ROW of that second image. Output the four new sprites in a2x2 sheet, reading left-to-right then next row, transparent background, equal square cells, safe generous margins. Do not copy either endpoint, redraw genuine joint changes with smooth arcs.
Row1 midpoint: far holding wrist/guard halfway from low up-left weapon into raised nearly upright weapon; shaft direction about-114deg from screen-right, holding elbow naturally bends, near hand empty halfway along its short release arc. Row2 midpoint: weapon/wrist halfway from upright to upper-right lift; shaft about-69deg, not reversing up-left; maintain a complete far forearm and free near arm. Row3 midpoint: halfway from diagonal upper-right into final behind-head shoulder carry; shaft about-5deg, far gold guard/hand screen-left of the head, hair/head occlude only the middle shaft with distal crown visible on screen-right; the weapon moves as one rigid object. Row4 midpoint: between knee-drive and forward precontact: near thigh remains forward, near lower leg unfolds halfway, rear ankle/toes push off naturally, coordinated pelvis/torso and free-arm counter-swing. Preserve the changing support/flight implied by the endpoints rather than pinning both feet.
Use the SAME consistent Kingdom Key physical form in all four: black handle aligned with blue collar and straight silver shaft, centered gold guard, unchanged three-tooth crown shape, attached pommel chain, slight foreground tip during carry. No shortened blade, detached shaft, inverted wrists, missing hand, glove gear, effects, text or separate layers. Match the endpoint body/head size and relative canvas placement; no per-pose zoom, scaled copies, mirrors, crossfades or motion blur. Keep full weapon and both boots inside each cell. These will be inserted into the existing sequence; generate only these four missing complete drawings.
